name: com.novagames.sdk
description: Ads (MAX/AdMob), Firebase (Analytics, Remote Config, Crashlytics), Adjust, UMP/ATT, Unity IAP, local notifications, no-internet and rating popups behind one static Nova* API. Vendor plugins are installed by the game; each adapter compiles only when its vendor is present. Docs: Docs/Guide.md, Docs/Overview.md.

samples.description: Demo scene, sample NovaSdkSettings and config assets, RemoteKey/GameRemoteConfig to copy into the game.
